sentences.text: The Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme was asked to investigate how the scheme was created and run, responses to concerns, debt collection and its human and economic effects.

sentences.text: It examined income averaging, automated decisions, debt recovery and the roles of legal advisers and oversight agencies.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that income averaging produced inaccurate debts using a method the social security legislation did not permit.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the scheme caused trauma and was a costly failure of public administration.

sentences.text: The Commission made 57 recommendations, including changes to recipient support, budget safeguards, automated decisions, debt recovery and public service accountability.
